average absolute monthly changes of reproductive and child health indicators
cohort: Participants were pregnant women, newborns, children, and adolescents in Haiti whose health data was recorded in the Haitian Unique Health Information System from August 2018 to September 2021.
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a statistically significant decline in most reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health indicators in Haiti.
